heatmapIntensityFactors.title: What tints a day (sport calendar)
heatmapIntensityFactors.intro: Day color blends several signals; no single number overrides everything.
heatmapIntensityFactors.bulletLevel: Level 0–4: checked program exercises, street reps/load, duration (holds), Today complementary, Garmin when no street.
heatmapIntensityFactors.bulletLoad: Weighted strength load: reps × intensity coefficient × load bonus (kg moved per rep vs your median).
heatmapIntensityFactors.bulletGarmin: Active kcal, steps above your usual baseline, Garmin intensity minutes (moderate / vigorous).
heatmapIntensityFactors.bulletProgram: Program completion ratio for that day (tint bonus).
heatmapIntensityFactors.bulletFeedback: Session difficulty when session feedback is filled in.
heatmapIntensityFactors.bulletVolumeRel: Daily kg×reps volume: small adjustment vs month-to-date median and vs the previous ~3 weeks.
heatmapIntensityFactors.volumeDedupeNote: If multiple variants (e.g. week A/B) are checked for the same exercise on the same day, only the entry with the most reps counts — same as strength recap and XP.

colorMix.title: Cell color (multi-signal)
colorMix.subtitle: The gradient favors logged street load and endurance; kcal and steps weigh less; Garmin moderate vs vigorous minutes are weighted (vigorous > moderate; walking days damp moderate); session feel nudges slightly; heavy walking days are damped.
colorMix.intensitySplit: split mod. {{mod}} min · vigorous {{vig}} min — score equivalent ≈ {{effective}} min (vigorous counts full; moderate discounted on walk-heavy days)
colorMix.walkNote: Walking-heavy day: active-time contribution is reduced for realism.
colorMix.feedbackNone: No session feel logged for this day.
colorMix.scaleExplainer: Cell colors: light green (your quietest day in the displayed range) to deep red (your busiest). Percentages show the mix; numbers on the right are your real values that day.
colorMix.synergyLine: Same-day street + endurance bonus: ×{{mult}} on the combined index.
colorMix.cardioSplit: Garmin cardio time (this day): walk {{walk}} min · run {{run}} min · other {{other}} min

equiv.title: Indicative scale (day-to-day comparisons)
equiv.intro: These are heuristics, not official MET tables—anchors to connect street work, Garmin, and color.
equiv.b1: ≈ {{kcal}} useful active kcal ≈ 1 visual load unit (order of magnitude).
equiv.b2: ≈ {{steps}} marginal steps above your usual baseline ≈ 1 unit (capped in the blend).
equiv.b3: 1 street rep at intensity coefficient 1 (e.g. simple dumbbell curl) ≈ 1 calendar load unit; per-exercise stars already scale load.
equiv.b4: Intervals vs easy running: duration alone is not enough—pace, workout type (intervals/tempo/easy), and HR feed into the endurance load already computed for the day.
equiv.b5: How notes interact (e.g. hard session + lots of walking): feel 1–5 nudges the score; walk-heavy days dampen intensity inferred from active time.
equiv.todayApprox: For this date, rough internal units: ~+{{kcalU}} from useful active kcal, ~+{{stepU}} from marginal steps (calendar-only anchors).
